Confirm if two or more Christmas or winter-tagged games enter Top Earning or Up-and-Coming by 2026-11-24; refute if Run a Christmas Tree Lot leaves Top Earning within a week and no other Christmas game follows.

qualitative_updates.note: Three ragdoll sandboxes entered Top Earning on scale (Ragdoll Physics 2, Ragdoll Research, WRECKED), Bloody Ragdoll Physics (10 days) leads Up-and-Coming and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll rose 62; Physics is the best Up-and-Coming title keyword (r=+0.40).

Steal Eggs From Tsunami! and Kick a Lucky Block left Most Popular a day after entering, Bike For Egg (-12) and Scare Your Neighbor (-15) fell there, steal loops lose Top Trending momentum (r=-0.49) and steal mechanics sit lower on Up-and-Coming (-0.43); Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular.
HUSH: They can hear (sound-hunting extraction, 46 days, 11.9M visits) and Steal Or Die (voice-aware monster) were profiled on Top Earning; DONT SPLASH holds the Most Popular top group.

10 Player Flee (-85) and Find Animal Bones (-68) fell on Top Earning and Stand Upright: Rebooted [HALLOWEEN] left it, while Forsaken [UPD] rose 37 on Most Popular after an update, as the hypothesis expects.

Malam Bersama Kaka, a new Indonesian house-horror entry, reached Up-and-Coming at 13 days with a 65% like ratio, the pattern this hypothesis describes; Angkot Simulator Indonesia and Sepeda Ontel Simulator show the same regional pull outside horror.

Skate Tree entered Most Popular at 38 days but sits among its weakest, HOOP JAM! fell on both Top Trending (-21) and Up-and-Coming (-39), sports loops hold the 19th median Most Popular percentile and Soccer stays the worst Most Popular keyword (r=-0.50).
